title: 第十一章寒沙埋旧怨剑指恶人巢第十二章侠骨逢霜雪孤剑映寒星
content_zh:
朔风卷着碎沙，像无数把冰冷的碎刃，刮在萧琰的脸上，生疼刺骨。他一身玄色劲装早已被风沙浸得发灰，衣摆处还沾着未干的血渍，那是昨日斩杀两名胡啸天手下余孽时留下的痕迹。腰间的“寒锋剑”裹着粗布，剑鞘上的纹路被风沙磨得模糊，却依旧能透出一股逼人的寒气，一如它的主人，眼底藏着化不开的冰封与恨意。
这里是漠北荒原的边缘，世人称其为“乱骨滩”。传言数十年间，无数商旅、流民、甚至江湖人士，都丧命于此，尸骨无人收敛，最终被漫天寒沙掩埋，只留下一片荒芜与死寂，连飞鸟都不肯在此多做停留，唯有狂风呼啸，似在诉说着无尽的冤屈与悲凉。萧琰循着线索，一路追至此地，脚下的黄沙松软异常，每走一步，都像是踩在无数冤魂的骸骨之上，发出细微的“咯吱”声响，听得人头皮发紧。
他停下脚步，抬手挡开迎面而来的风沙，目光缓缓扫过眼前的荒原。天色阴沉得可怕，铅灰色的云层低低压着，仿佛随时都会倾落下漫天风雪。远处的沙丘连绵起伏，被风沙雕琢得奇形怪状，像是蛰伏的巨兽，沉默地注视着这片埋满罪恶的土地。近处的沙地上，散落着无数残缺不全的尸骨，有的露着惨白的颅骨，空洞的眼窝朝着天空，似在控诉着生前遭受的苦难；有的只剩下一截断裂的手臂，指骨扭曲，仿佛还在做着最后的挣扎；还有的尸骨被风沙半掩半露，骨骼上还残留着些许衣物的碎片，早已被风沙侵蚀得破败不堪，看不清原本的模样。
一股浓烈的腐臭气息混杂着风沙的干涩，钻入萧琰的鼻腔，那气味刺鼻难闻，却远不及他心中的痛楚与愤怒。他缓缓蹲下身，指尖轻轻抚过一截残缺的肋骨，骨骼冰凉刺骨，指尖传来粗糙的触感，那是风沙长期侵蚀的痕迹。这截肋骨很细，看模样，应当是个孩童的骸骨，骨骼上还留着一道清晰的刀痕，深浅不一，显然是被人残忍杀害的。萧琰的指尖微微颤抖，眼底的恨意愈发浓烈，连周身的气息都变得愈发冰冷。
他想起了三年前的那个夜晚，也是这样一个寒风呼啸的日子。他的师门“青云宗”，一夜之间被人血洗殆尽，师父、师娘、师兄师姐，还有宗门里那些无辜的弟子，无论老幼，无一幸免。他当时奉命下山采购物资，侥幸逃过一劫，可当他连夜赶回宗门时，看到的却是和眼前一样的惨状——遍地尸骨，血流成河，宗门的牌匾被劈成两半，大殿被付之一炬，只剩下一片断壁残垣，空气中弥漫着血腥味与焦糊味，那是他毕生难忘的画面。
后来他才查到，这一切的始作俑者，便是江湖中人人闻之色变的恶人胡啸天。胡啸天出身市井，性情残暴，心狠手辣，早年拜入邪派门下，习得一身阴毒武功，后来自立门户，招揽了一群亡命之徒，在漠北一带盘踞，烧杀抢掠，无恶不作，商旅流民深受其害，就连江湖中的一些小门小派，也难逃他的毒手。青云宗只因无意间撞见胡啸天走私军火、残害百姓的罪行，便遭到了灭门之祸。
这三年来，萧琰隐姓埋名，四处漂泊，一边苦练武功，一边追查胡啸天的踪迹。他走过江南水乡，踏过塞北大漠，吃过无数苦，受过无数伤，数次身陷险境，九死一生，只为能找到胡啸天的老巢，为师门上下报仇雪恨。他曾在寒夜里露宿荒野，也曾在暴雨中与胡啸天的手下死战，身上的伤痕一道叠着一道，每一道伤痕，都是他复仇之路的见证，每一道伤痕，都加深了他心中的恨意。
“寒沙埋旧怨……”萧琰低声呢喃着，声音沙哑，带着无尽的悲凉与决绝。他缓缓站起身，抬手拂去指尖的黄沙，目光再次扫过眼前的遍地尸骨，这些尸骨之中，或许有和他一样，被胡啸天残害的无辜之人，或许有试图反抗却惨遭毒手的江湖义士，他们的冤屈，他们的恨意，都被这漫天寒沙掩埋，无人知晓。而他，萧琰，今日便要带着这些冤魂的恨意，踏平胡啸天的老巢，让胡啸天血债血偿，让这些冤屈得以昭雪。
他握紧了腰间的寒锋剑，粗布之下，剑鞘传来一丝冰凉的触感，似在回应他心中的恨意。朔风依旧呼啸，风沙依旧漫天，可萧琰的眼神却变得愈发坚定，没有丝毫的畏惧与退缩。他知道，胡啸天的老巢就在这乱骨滩的深处，地势险要，戒备森严，里面布满了陷阱，还有无数亡命之徒把守，此行凶险万分，稍有不慎，便会葬身于此，和眼前的这些尸骨一样，被寒沙掩埋，成为永恒的遗憾。可他别无选择，复仇之路，一旦开启，便没有回头的可能，哪怕前方是刀山火海，哪怕前方是万丈深渊，他也要一往无前，至死方休。
萧琰深吸一口气，压下心中翻涌的情绪，脚步缓缓挪动，朝着乱骨滩的深处走去。他的步伐轻盈而坚定，每一步都走得格外谨慎，目光警惕地扫视着四周，生怕错过任何一丝线索，也生怕触发隐藏的陷阱。脚下的黄沙越来越松软，散落的尸骨也越来越多，有的尸骨相互交错，堆积在一起，形成了一座小小的“骨丘”，有的尸骨则被风沙完全掩埋，只留下一个小小的土包，隐约能看到下面凸起的轮廓。
走了约莫一个时辰，天色愈发阴沉，狂风也愈发猛烈，风沙迷得人睁不开眼睛。萧琰不得不停下脚步，找了一处背风的沙丘，暂时躲避风沙。他靠在冰冷的沙丘上，微微喘息，目光依旧警惕地注视着四周。就在这时，他忽然注意到，不远处的沙地上，有一串新鲜的脚印，脚印杂乱不一，显然是一群人留下的，脚印的方向，正是乱骨滩的深处。而且，脚印旁边，还散落着一些破碎的布片，布片的颜色是黑色的，上面绣着一朵狰狞的骷髅头，这是胡啸天手下的标志——胡啸天的手下，皆身着黑衣，衣摆处绣着骷髅头，以此彰显他们的残暴与凶狠。
萧琰的眼神一凝，心中顿时燃起一丝希望。他知道，这一定是胡啸天的手下，他们或许是刚从老巢出来巡逻，或许是去乱骨滩边缘处理什么事情。这串脚印，便是通往胡啸天老巢的线索。他缓缓站起身，拍了拍身上的黄沙，小心翼翼地循着脚印，继续朝着深处走去。他不敢走得太快，生怕惊动了前方的巡逻之人，只能放慢脚步，压低身形，借着沙丘的掩护，一步步前行。
又走了约莫半个时辰，风沙渐渐小了一些，远处的沙丘之间，隐约出现了一道黑色的轮廓，像是一座城堡，矗立在荒原之中，显得格外突兀与阴森。萧琰心中一紧，他知道，那大概率就是胡啸天的老巢了。他放慢脚步，缓缓靠近，躲在一座高大的沙丘后面，探出头，仔细观察着前方的景象。
那是一座依山而建的山寨，山寨的围墙是用巨大的黑石砌成的，高达数丈，围墙之上，布满了尖刺，尖刺闪烁着冰冷的寒光，让人望而生畏。围墙的四周，有四座瞭望塔，瞭望塔上，每一座都站着两名黑衣守卫，他们手持弓箭，目光警惕地扫视着四周，一举一动都格外谨慎，丝毫不敢懈怠。山寨的大门是用厚重的实木打造的，门上钉着无数铁钉，门楣之上，挂着一块黑色的牌匾，牌匾上用金色的颜料写着两个狰狞的大字——“黑风寨”，那便是胡啸天老巢的名字。
大门的两侧，各站着四名黑衣守卫，他们身材高大，面色凶狠，手持长刀，腰间别着暗器，周身散发着一股残暴的气息，如同凶神恶煞一般，死死地守在大门前，不让任何人靠近。除此之外，山寨的四周，还散落着一些巡逻的黑衣守卫，他们分成几组，每组三四人，手持兵器，来回巡逻，警惕性极高，任何一丝风吹草动，都逃不过他们的眼睛。
萧琰仔细观察着山寨的布局，心中暗暗盘算着。黑风寨依山而建，地势险要，易守难攻，围墙高大坚固，又有众多守卫把守，想要正面强攻，无疑是以卵击石，根本不可能成功，只会白白送死。而且，他还注意到，山寨的周围，似乎布满了陷阱，那些看似平坦的沙地上，隐约有一些细微的痕迹，那是陷阱的伪装，一旦不小心踩上去，便会触发陷阱，轻则受伤，重则丧命。
他想起了之前追查胡啸天时，遇到的那些陷阱，有的是深坑，里面布满了尖刺；有的是毒箭阵，一旦触发，便会有无数毒箭从四面八方射来；还有的是绊索，一旦被绊倒，便会被周围的守卫围杀。胡啸天心思缜密，性情残暴，他深知自己作恶多端，树敌无数，所以在老巢的防御上，做足了准备，不放过任何一个细节，就是为了防止有人前来寻仇。
萧琰缓缓收回目光，压低身形，躲在沙丘后面，心中思绪万千。他知道，想要进入黑风寨，必须找到一个隐蔽的入口，避开守卫的视线和那些隐藏的陷阱。他再次抬起头，目光仔细扫视着山寨的四周，从瞭望塔到围墙，从大门到巡逻的守卫，不放过任何一个角落。
过了许久，他终于注意到，在山寨西侧的围墙下方，有一个小小的洞口，洞口被黄沙半掩着，周围长满了枯黄的杂草，隐蔽性极强，如果不仔细观察，根本发现不了。而且，那个洞口的位置，正好在瞭望塔的视野盲区，巡逻的守卫也很少会走到那里，无疑是进入黑风寨的最佳入口。
萧琰心中一喜，缓缓挪动身形，朝着西侧的围墙悄悄靠近。他依旧压低身形，借着沙丘和杂草的掩护，一步步前行，目光警惕地注视着四周的守卫，生怕被他们发现。巡逻的守卫来回走动，脚步声清晰可闻，他们的笑声和呵斥声，也不时传入萧琰的耳中，那些声音刺耳难听，充满了残暴与嚣张，让萧琰心中的恨意再次翻涌。他紧紧咬着牙，压下心中的怒火，不敢有丝毫的大意，每一步都走得格外谨慎，大气都不敢喘一口。

好不容易，他终于来到了西侧的围墙下方，躲在一片枯黄的杂草丛中。他缓缓探出头，仔细观察着那个小小的洞口，洞口约莫一人高，宽度刚好能容纳一个人通过，洞口周围的黄沙和杂草，显然是有人刻意伪装的，用来掩盖洞口的存在。他又抬头看了看瞭望塔上的守卫，他们依旧目光警惕地扫视着远方，并没有注意到下方的动静，巡逻的守卫也还在远处来回走动，一时半会儿不会走到这里。
萧琰深吸一口气，抓住这个机会，缓缓站起身，快步走到洞口前，弯腰拂去洞口的黄沙和杂草，露出了洞口的全貌。洞口内部漆黑一片，伸手不见五指，一股阴冷潮湿的气息从洞口内部传来，混杂着淡淡的血腥味和霉味，让人不寒而栗。他知道，洞口内部大概率也布满了陷阱，或许还有守卫把守，但他没有退缩，复仇的信念，支撑着他一步步前行。
他缓缓拔出腰间的寒锋剑，剑身出鞘的瞬间，发出一声清脆的“铮”鸣，划破了周围的死寂，在空旷的荒原之中，显得格外刺耳。他握紧寒锋剑，剑尖微微下垂，借着微弱的光线，小心翼翼地踏入了洞口。洞口内部狭窄而陡峭，脚下的泥土湿滑异常，一不小心，便会摔倒。萧琰放慢脚步，一步步前行，目光警惕地扫视着四周，剑身微微晃动，随时准备应对可能出现的危险。
走了约莫十几步，洞口内部渐渐变得宽敞了一些，光线也稍微亮了一些，隐约能看到周围的墙壁上，布满了青苔，显得格外潮湿。就在这时，他忽然听到前方传来一阵细微的脚步声，还有人的低语声，声音模糊不清，却能清晰地传入他的耳中。萧琰心中一紧，立刻停下脚步，压低身形，屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地躲到一旁的墙壁后面，目光警惕地注视着前方的动静。
他缓缓探出头，借着微弱的光线，看到前方不远处，有两名黑衣守卫，正背对着他，靠在墙壁上，低声交谈着，手中还拿着长刀，神色慵懒，显然是在站岗。他们的衣摆处，绣着狰狞的骷髅头，正是胡啸天的手下。萧琰的眼底闪过一丝冷光，握紧了手中的寒锋剑，心中暗暗盘算着，想要悄无声息地解决掉这两名守卫，不被其他人发现。
他深吸一口气，压下心中的情绪，脚步轻盈地朝着两名守卫悄悄靠近。他的动作极轻，脚下没有发出丝毫的声响，如同一只蛰伏的猎豹，悄悄靠近自己的猎物。两名守卫依旧在低声交谈着，丝毫没有察觉到危险的降临，他们谈论着钱财，谈论着女人，语气中充满了嚣张与贪婪，丝毫没有意识到，死亡已经悄然降临到他们的身边。
就在萧琰靠近两名守卫还有几步之遥的时候，其中一名守卫忽然察觉到了什么，缓缓转过身，目光警惕地扫视着四周，厉声呵斥道：“谁在那里？出来！”萧琰心中一凛，知道自己被发现了，他没有丝毫的犹豫，身形一闪，如同离弦之箭一般，朝着那名守卫冲了过去。
那名守卫脸色一变，显然没有想到，会有人出现在这里，他来不及反应，只能下意识地举起手中的长刀，朝着萧琰砍了过去。萧琰眼神冰冷，不闪不避，手中的寒锋剑微微一扬，发出一声清脆的“铮”鸣，精准地挡住了那名守卫的长刀。刀剑相撞，发出一阵刺耳的金铁交鸣之声，火星四溅。那名守卫只觉得手臂一麻，长刀险些脱手而出，他心中大惊，没想到眼前这个人的武功竟然如此之高。
另一名守卫也反应了过来，脸色大变，立刻举起手中的长刀，朝着萧琰的后背砍了过去，想要偷袭萧琰。萧琰早已察觉到了身后的动静，身形微微一侧，巧妙地避开了那名守卫的偷袭，同时，手中的寒锋剑顺势一挑，剑尖精准地刺入了第一名守卫的胸口。第一名守卫脸色惨白，双眼圆睁，嘴巴大张，想要说什么，却发不出任何声音，鲜血从他的胸口喷涌而出，染红了他的黑衣，也染红了周围的墙壁。萧琰手腕一拧，剑身抽出，第一名守卫轰然倒地，当场气绝身亡。
另一名守卫看到同伴被杀，吓得魂飞魄散，脸色惨白如纸，双腿微微颤抖，再也没有了之前的嚣张与慵懒，他想要转身逃跑，却被萧琰一把抓住了后领，死死地按在墙壁上。萧琰的眼神冰冷，如同万年寒冰，他握紧手中的寒锋剑，剑尖抵住了那名守卫的咽喉，厉声质问道：“胡啸天在哪里？黑风寨里面还有多少守卫？陷阱都布置在什么地方？”
那名守卫吓得浑身发抖，牙齿打颤，脸上布满了恐惧的神色，他看着抵在自己咽喉处的寒锋剑，感受着剑身传来的冰冷寒意，生怕萧琰一不小心，就会割断他的喉咙。他连忙说道：“大……大侠，饶命啊，我……我都说，我都说。”
萧琰眼神一冷，加大了手中的力度，剑尖微微刺入那名守卫的咽喉，渗出一丝鲜血，厉声说道：“少废话，快说！”
“是是是，”那名守卫连忙点头，声音颤抖地说道，“寨主……寨主在山寨的大殿里面，此刻正在和手下的头目议事。黑风寨里面，一共有三百多名守卫，分成三组，一组守在大门和瞭望塔，一组在山寨里面巡逻，还有一组守在大殿周围，保护寨主的安全。陷阱……陷阱主要布置在山寨的四周和入口处，西侧的这个洞口，是寨主特意留下的密道，平时很少有人知道，只有少数几个头目才能进入，里面没有太多的陷阱，只有这一处岗哨。”
萧琰仔细听着，目光警惕地注视着那名守卫的神色，想要判断他说的是不是真话。他知道，胡啸天心思缜密，手下的守卫也大多狡猾多疑，眼前这个守卫，很有可能在说谎，想要趁机逃跑，或者引诱他进入陷阱。
似乎察觉到了萧琰的怀疑，那名守卫连忙说道：“大侠，我……我说的都是真的，我不敢说谎啊，求你饶了我吧，我再也不敢作恶了，我现在就离开黑风寨，再也不回来。”
萧琰眼神冰冷，没有丝毫的怜悯，他想起了师门的惨状，想起了眼前的遍地尸骨，想起了那些被胡啸天残害的无辜之人，心中的恨意如同潮水一般翻涌。他缓缓说道：“你作恶多端，双手沾满了无辜之人的鲜血，今日，便是你的死期。”
话音未落，萧琰手腕一拧，手中的寒锋剑瞬间刺入了那名守卫的咽喉，鲜血喷涌而出，那名守卫连哼都没哼一声，便轰然倒地，当场气绝身亡。萧琰收回寒锋剑，抬手擦去剑身上的鲜血，剑身再次恢复了冰冷的寒光。他看着地上的两具尸体，眼神没有丝毫的波动，在他看来，这些作恶多端的人，死不足惜，他们的死，只是为那些无辜的冤魂，讨回了一丝公道。
萧琰深吸一口气，压下心中翻涌的情绪，目光警惕地扫视着四周，确认没有其他的守卫之后，便继续朝着洞口内部前行。他知道，接下来的路，会更加艰险，黑风寨里面，还有三百多名守卫，还有无数的陷阱，而胡啸天本人，武功高强，心狠手辣，想要杀他，绝非易事。可他别无选择，复仇的火焰，早已在他心中燃烧了三年，今日，他一定要踏平黑风寨，让胡啸天血债血偿，为师门上下，为所有被胡啸天残害的无辜之人，报仇雪恨。
洞口内部的通道，渐渐变得宽敞了一些，光线也越来越亮，隐约能看到前方不远处，有一道出口，出口处，传来了隐约的人声和脚步声。萧琰知道，那便是黑风寨的内部了。他放慢脚步，压低身形，小心翼翼地靠近出口，目光警惕地扫视着前方的动静，手中的寒锋剑紧紧握在手中，随时准备应对可能出现的危险。
他缓缓探出头，借着出口处的光线，仔细观察着黑风寨内部的景象。黑风寨内部，布局杂乱，四处都是低矮的木屋，木屋的墙壁是用泥土砌成的，屋顶覆盖着茅草，显得格外简陋。木屋的周围，散落着一些兵器和杂物，还有一些黑衣守卫，来回巡逻，神色警惕。远处，有一座高大的大殿，大殿是用青砖砌成的，屋顶覆盖着黑色的瓦片，显得格外威严，那便是黑风寨的大殿，胡啸天就在里面。

萧琰的目光，死死地盯着那座大殿，眼底的恨意几乎要溢出来。他知道，胡啸天就在那座大殿里面，他的仇人，就在眼前。三年的隐忍，三年的漂泊，三年的苦练，只为今日这一刻。他缓缓握紧手中的寒锋剑，剑身微微颤抖，似在回应他心中的恨意与决绝。
朔风依旧在黑风寨的上空呼啸，卷起漫天风沙，大殿的屋檐下，悬挂的灯笼，在狂风中摇曳，发出微弱的光芒，映照著这座充满罪恶与血腥的山寨。萧琰深吸一口气，压下心中翻涌的情绪，身形一闪，从出口处跃出，如同一只展翅的雄鹰，朝着那座大殿，悄悄靠近。他的脚步轻盈而坚定，每一步，都朝着复仇的终点，迈进了一步；每一步，都承载着无数冤魂的期盼与恨意。
寒沙埋尽旧怨，利剑直指恶巢。萧琰知道，一场血战，即将爆发，他不知道自己能否活着走出这座黑风寨，不知道自己能否成功复仇，但他知道，他不会退缩，不会畏惧，哪怕拼尽全力，哪怕粉身碎骨，他也要让胡啸天血债血偿，让那些被残害的冤魂，得以安息。他的身影，在漫天风沙之中，显得格外单薄，却又格外坚定，如同寒沙之中的一株野草，在狂风暴雨之中，顽强地生长，带着无尽的恨意与决绝，朝着罪恶的源头，一步步前行。

The wind blew up the broken sand, like countless cold blades, and struck Xiao Yan's face, causing pain and bone-piercing pain. His black attire had already been soaked gray by the wind and sand, and the hem of his clothes was still stained with wet blood, which was the trace left when he killed two remnants of Hu Xiaotian's men yesterday. The "Han Feng Sword" at the waist was wrapped in coarse cloth, and the lines on the scabbard were blurred by the wind and sand, but it still exuded a chilling air. Just like its owner, there was ice and hatred in his eyes that could not be dissolved.
This is the edge of the Mobei Wasteland, and the world calls it the "Chaos Bone Beach". Rumor has it that countless business travelers, refugees, and even people from all walks of life died here over the past few decades. Their bodies were not recovered, and were eventually buried by the cold sand in the sky, leaving only a desolation and deathly silence. Even the birds refused to stay here, and only the howling wind seemed to tell endless injustice and sorrow. Xiao Yan followed the clues and chased all the way to this place. The yellow sand under his feet was extremely soft. Every step he took was like stepping on the bones of countless wronged souls, making a subtle "crunching" sound that made people's scalp tighten.
He stopped, raised his hand to block the oncoming wind and sand, and slowly scanned the wasteland in front of him. The sky was terrifyingly gloomy, with leaden gray clouds weighing low, as if the sky would be filled with snow at any time. The sand dunes in the distance are rolling and undulating, carved into strange shapes by the wind and sand, like dormant giant beasts, silently watching this land full of sin. Countless mutilated corpses are scattered on the sand nearby. Some have pale skulls exposed, with empty eye sockets facing the sky, as if they are complaining about the suffering they suffered during their lives; some have only a broken arm, with twisted finger bones, as if they are still making a final struggle; some bones are half-covered and half-exposed by the wind and sand, and there are still some fragments of clothing on the bones. They have long been eroded by the wind and sand, and their original appearance cannot be seen clearly.
A strong rancid smell mixed with the dryness of wind and sand penetrated Xiao Yan's nose. The smell was pungent and unpleasant, but it was far less than the pain and anger in his heart. He slowly squatted down and gently touched a broken rib with his fingertips. The bones were cold and biting, and there was a rough touch on his fingertips, which was the trace of long-term erosion by wind and sand. The ribs were very thin and looked like they were the bones of a child. There was a clear knife mark on the bones, varying in depth. It was obvious that someone had brutally killed him. Xiao Yan's fingertips trembled slightly, the hatred in his eyes became stronger, and even the breath around him became colder.
He thought of that night three years ago, which was also such a cold and windy day. His sect, "Qingyun Sect", was wiped out by blood overnight. His master, his wife, his brothers and sisters, as well as the innocent disciples in the sect, young and old, were all spared. He was ordered to go down the mountain to purchase supplies and was lucky to escape. However, when he rushed back to the sect overnight, he saw the same tragic scene as before - corpses everywhere, blood flowing into rivers, the sect's plaque was split in half, the main hall was burned to the ground, leaving only a ruined wall, and the air was filled with the smell of blood and burnt. It was a scene he would never forget.
Only later did he find out that the instigator of all this was Hu Xiaotian, a villain who was known to everyone in the world. Hu Xiaotian was born in the market, with a cruel temperament and a ruthless heart. He became a disciple of an evil sect in his early years and learned vicious martial arts. Later, he established his own sect and recruited a group of desperadoes. They settled in the Mobei area, burning, killing, looting, and committing all kinds of evil. The businessmen and refugees suffered greatly, and even some small sects and sects in the world could not escape his vicious hands. The Qingyun Sect was wiped out just because they accidentally stumbled upon Hu Xiaotian's crimes of smuggling arms and killing people.
In the past three years, Xiao Yan has been living incognito, wandering around, practicing martial arts hard while tracking down Hu Xiaotian. He walked through the water towns in the south of the Yangtze River and the desert in the north of the Great Wall, suffered countless hardships, suffered countless injuries, was in danger several times, and narrowly escaped death, just to find Hu Xiaotian's lair and serve as his master's disciple.Take revenge. He once slept in the wilderness on cold nights, and fought to the death with Hu Xiaotian's men in heavy rains. The scars on his body were piled one on top of another. Each scar was a witness to his journey of revenge, and each scar deepened the hatred in his heart.
"Hansha buries old grudges..." Xiao Yan murmured in a low voice, his voice hoarse, filled with endless sadness and determination. He slowly stood up, raised his hand to brush off the yellow sand on his fingertips, and glanced at the corpses lying in front of him again. Among these corpses, there might be innocent people who were murdered by Hu Xiaotian like him, or there might be heroes who tried to resist but were brutally killed. Their grievances and hatred were buried by the cold sand in the sky, and no one knew about it. And he, Xiao Yan, will carry the hatred of these wronged souls today to destroy Hu Xiaotian's lair, make Hu Xiaotian pay with blood, and let these injustices be vindicated.
He tightened his grip on the Hanfeng Sword at his waist. Under the coarse cloth, there was a cold touch from the scabbard, which seemed to respond to the hatred in his heart. The wind was still howling, and the wind and sand were still filling the sky, but Xiao Yan's eyes became more determined, without any fear or flinching. He knew that Hu Xiaotian's lair was deep in the bone beach. The terrain was dangerous and heavily guarded. It was full of traps and guarded by countless desperadoes. This trip was extremely dangerous. If you were not careful, you would be buried here. Like the bones in front of you, you would be buried in the cold sand and become an eternal regret. But he has no choice. Once the road to revenge begins, there is no possibility of turning back. Even if there are mountains of swords and seas of fire ahead, and even if there is an abyss ahead, he will continue to move forward until death.
Xiao Yan took a deep breath, suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, and moved slowly towards the depths of the Bone Beach. His steps were light and firm, and every step he took was extremely cautious. His eyes scanned the surroundings vigilantly, for fear of missing any clues or triggering hidden traps. The yellow sand underfoot is getting softer and softer, and more and more corpses are scattered. Some bones are intertwined and stacked together to form a small "bone mound". Some bones are completely buried by the wind and sand, leaving only a small earth bag, and the convex outline below can be vaguely seen.
After walking for about an hour, the sky became darker and gloomier, the wind became more violent, and the wind and sand were so confusing that people couldn't keep their eyes open. Xiao Yan had to stop and find a leeward sand dune to temporarily avoid the wind and sand. He leaned on the cold sand dune, panting slightly, still looking around with vigilance. At this moment, he suddenly noticed that there was a string of fresh footprints on the sand not far away. The footprints were messy and messy. They were obviously left by a group of people. The direction of the footprints was exactly in the depths of Bone Beach. Moreover, there are some broken pieces of cloth scattered next to the footprints. The cloth is black in color and has a ferocious skull embroidered on it. This is the symbol of Hu Xiaotian's men - Hu Xiaotian's men are all dressed in black with skulls embroidered on the hems of their clothes to show their cruelty and ferocity.
Xiao Yan's eyes condensed, and a glimmer of hope suddenly ignited in his heart. He knew that these must be Hu Xiaotian's men. They might have just come out from their lair to patrol, or they might be going to deal with something at the edge of Luangu Beach. This string of footprints is the clue leading to Hu Xiaotian's lair. He stood up slowly, patted the yellow sand on his body, carefully followed the footprints, and continued walking deeper. He didn't dare to walk too fast for fear of alarming the patrols ahead, so he could only slow down, lower his body, and move forward step by step under the cover of the sand dunes.
After walking for about half an hour, the wind and sand gradually became lighter. Between the dunes in the distance, a black outline appeared vaguely, like a castle, standing in the wilderness, looking particularly abrupt and eerie. Xiao Yan's heart tightened. He knew that it was most likely Hu Xiaotian's lair. He slowed down, approached slowly, hid behind a tall sand dune, stuck his head out, and looked carefullyObserving the scene ahead.
It was a cottage built on the mountain. The walls of the cottage were made of huge black stones, several feet high. The walls were covered with spikes, and the spikes shone with an icy cold light, which was intimidating. There are four watchtowers around the wall. On each watchtower, there are two guards in black. They hold bows and arrows and scan the surroundings with vigilance. They are extremely cautious in every move and do not dare to slack off at all. The door of the cottage is made of heavy solid wood with countless iron nails. On the lintel, there is a black plaque with two ferocious characters written in gold paint - "Black Wind Village", which is the name of Hu Xiaotian's old lair.
On both sides of the gate, there were four guards in black standing. They were tall and fierce-looking, holding long knives and concealed weapons on their waists. They exuded a brutal aura, like menacing gods. They stood guard in front of the gate and refused to let anyone get close. In addition, there are some patrolling guards in black scattered around the stronghold. They are divided into several groups, each group has three or four people, armed with weapons, patrolling back and forth. They are extremely vigilant, and no slightest sign of trouble can escape their eyes.
Xiao Yan carefully observed the layout of the village and made secret calculations in his heart. Black Wind Stronghold is built on a mountain. The terrain is difficult, easy to defend and difficult to attack. The walls are tall and strong, and there are many guards guarding them. If you want to attack head-on, you will undoubtedly be using an egg against a rock. It is impossible to succeed, and you will only die in vain. Moreover, he also noticed that the surroundings of the cottage seemed to be full of traps. There were some faint traces on the seemingly flat sand, which were the disguise of traps. Once he accidentally stepped on them, the traps would be triggered, which could cause injuries at worst and death at worst.
He remembered the traps he encountered when he was tracking down Hu Xiaotian. Some were deep pits filled with spikes; some were poisonous arrow arrays, and once triggered, countless poisonous arrows would be shot from all directions; and some were trip wires, and once tripped, the surrounding guards would kill them. Hu Xiaotian has a meticulous mind and a cruel temper. He knows that he has done many evil things and made countless enemies, so he has made adequate preparations for the defense of his lair and has not missed any detail, just to prevent anyone from coming to seek revenge.
Xiao Yan slowly withdrew his gaze, lowered his figure, and hid behind the sand dune, with many thoughts in his mind. He knew that if he wanted to enter Black Wind Village, he had to find a hidden entrance and avoid the guards' sight and hidden traps. He raised his head again and scanned the surroundings of the stronghold carefully, from the watchtower to the wall, from the gate to the patrolling guards, not sparing any corner.
After a long time, he finally noticed that there was a small hole under the wall on the west side of the village. The hole was half-covered by yellow sand and surrounded by withered yellow weeds. It was extremely concealed and could not be discovered without careful observation. Moreover, the location of the cave entrance is right in the blind spot of the watchtower, and patrolling guards rarely go there. It is undoubtedly the best entrance to Black Wind Village.
Xiao Yan felt happy, and slowly moved his body, quietly approaching the wall on the west side. He still kept his figure low, taking advantage of the cover of sand dunes and weeds to move forward step by step, watching the guards around him warily, for fear of being discovered by them. The patrolling guards walked back and forth, and their footsteps could be heard clearly. Their laughter and scoldings also reached Xiao Yan's ears from time to time. Those sounds were harsh and unpleasant, full of cruelty and arrogance, and the hatred in Xiao Yan's heart surged again. He gritted his teeth tightly and suppressed the anger in his heart. He did not dare to be careless in the slightest. He took every step with extreme caution and did not dare to take a breath.
With great difficulty, he finally arrived under the west wall and hid in a patch of withered weeds. He slowly poked his head out and carefully observed the small hole. The hole was about one person high and just wide enough for one person to pass through. The yellow sand and debris around the hole wereThe grass was obviously deliberately disguised by someone to cover up the existence of the cave entrance. He looked up at the guards on the watchtower again. They were still scanning the distance with vigilant eyes and did not notice the movement below. The patrolling guards were still walking back and forth in the distance and would not come here for a while.
Xiao Yan took a deep breath, seized this opportunity, stood up slowly, walked quickly to the entrance of the cave, bent down and brushed away the yellow sand and weeds at the entrance, revealing the entire entrance of the cave. The inside of the cave entrance was pitch black, and you couldn't see your fingers. A cold, damp breath came from inside the cave entrance, mixed with the faint smell of blood and mold, making people shudder. He knew that the inside of the cave was likely to be filled with traps, and perhaps guarded by guards, but he did not flinch, and his belief in revenge supported him to move forward step by step.
He slowly pulled out the Hanfeng sword from his waist. The moment the sword was unsheathed, it made a crisp "clang" sound, which cut through the dead silence around him and seemed particularly harsh in the empty wasteland. He held the Hanfeng Sword tightly, the tip of the sword drooped slightly, and carefully stepped into the cave entrance with the help of the faint light. The inside of the cave entrance is narrow and steep, and the soil under your feet is extremely slippery. If you are not careful, you will fall. Xiao Yan slowed down and moved forward step by step, scanning the surroundings with vigilance. The sword shook slightly, ready to deal with possible dangers at any time.
After walking for about ten steps, the inside of the cave gradually became wider and the light became slightly brighter. You could vaguely see that the surrounding walls were covered with moss and looked extremely moist. At this moment, he suddenly heard a faint sound of footsteps and someone's whisper in front of him. The sound was indistinct, but it could be clearly transmitted to his ears. Xiao Yan's heart tightened, and he immediately stopped, lowered his body, held his breath, and carefully hid behind the wall, watching the movement in front of him with vigilance.
He slowly poked his head out, and with the faint light, he saw two guards in black not far ahead, with their backs to him, leaning against the wall, talking in a low voice, with long knives in their hands, looking lazy, obviously on guard. There were ferocious skulls embroidered on the hems of their clothes, and they were none other than Hu Xiaotian's men. A cold light flashed in Xiao Yan's eyes, and he clenched the Hanfeng Sword in his hand, secretly planning in his heart to get rid of the two guards quietly without being discovered by others.
He took a deep breath, suppressed the emotions in his heart, and quietly approached the two guards with light steps. His movements were extremely light and his feet made no sound at all, like a dormant cheetah quietly approaching its prey. The two guards were still talking in a low voice, unaware of the danger coming. They talked about money and women, their voices full of arrogance and greed, and they did not realize that death had quietly come to them.
Just when Xiao Yan was still a few steps away from the two guards, one of the guards suddenly noticed something, turned around slowly, scanned the surroundings with vigilant eyes, and shouted sternly: "Who is there? Come out!" Xiao Yan's heart froze, knowing that he had been discovered. Without any hesitation, he flashed towards the guard like an arrow from a string.
The guard's expression changed. He obviously did not expect that someone would appear here. He had no time to react, so he could only subconsciously raise the long knife in his hand and slash at Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan's eyes were cold and he did not dodge or dodge. He raised the Hanfeng sword in his hand slightly and made a crisp "clang" sound, accurately blocking the guard's long knife. The swords collided, making a harsh sound of metal and iron, and sparks flying everywhere. The guard felt his arm go numb, and the sword almost came out of his hand. He was shocked. He didn't expect that the martial arts of the man in front of him was so high.
Another guard also reacted, his face changed drastically, he immediately raised the long knife in his hand and slashed Xiao Yan on the back.Go, want to sneak attack Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan had already noticed the movement behind him. He turned slightly to one side and cleverly avoided the guard's sneak attack. At the same time, he swung the Hanfeng Sword in his hand, and the tip of the sword accurately pierced the chest of the first guard. The first guard's face was pale, his eyes were wide open, and his mouth was open. He wanted to say something, but no sound came out. Blood spurted out from his chest, staining his black clothes and the surrounding walls red. Xiao Yan twisted his wrist and drew out the sword. The first guard fell to the ground and died on the spot.
Another guard was so frightened when he saw his companion being killed that his face was as pale as paper and his legs were shaking slightly. He no longer had the arrogance and laziness he had before. He wanted to turn around and run away, but Xiao Yan grabbed him by the collar and pinned him to the wall. Xiao Yan's eyes were cold, like thousands of years of ice. He clenched the Hanfeng Sword in his hand, put the tip of the sword against the guard's throat, and asked sternly: "Where is Hu Xiaotian? How many guards are there in Black Wind Stronghold? Where are the traps?"
The guard was trembling with fear, his teeth were chattering, and his face was full of fear. He looked at the Hanfeng sword at his throat, feeling the coldness coming from the sword, for fear that Xiao Yan would cut his throat if he was not careful. He hurriedly said: "Great...hero, spare your life, I...I said it all, I said it all."
Xiao Yan's eyes turned cold, and he increased the strength in his hand. The tip of the sword slightly penetrated the guard's throat, a trace of blood seeped out, and he said sternly: "Stop talking nonsense and speak quickly!"
"Yes, yes," the guard nodded quickly and said in a trembling voice, "The village master...the village master is in the main hall of the village, discussing matters with his boss at the moment. There are more than 300 guards in Heifeng Village, divided into three groups, one group guarding the gate and watchtower, one group patrolling inside the village, and one group The team guards around the main hall to protect the safety of the village owner. Traps... The traps are mainly placed around the village and at the entrance. The hole on the west side is a secret passage specially left by the village owner. Usually, few people know about it. Only a few bosses can enter. There are not many traps in it, only this guard post. "
Xiao Yan listened carefully and watched the guard's expression warily, trying to judge whether he was telling the truth. He knew that Hu Xiaotian was very thoughtful and most of his guards were cunning and suspicious. The guard in front of him was probably lying and wanted to take advantage of the opportunity to escape or lure him into a trap.
Seemingly aware of Xiao Yan's suspicion, the guard quickly said: "My hero, I... everything I said is true. I don't dare to lie. Please forgive me. I don't dare to do evil anymore. I will leave Black Wind Stronghold now and never come back."
Xiao Yan's eyes were cold and devoid of any mercy. He thought of the tragic situation of his master's sect, the corpses everywhere in front of him, and the innocent people who were murdered by Hu Xiaotian, and the hatred in his heart surged like a tide. He said slowly: "You have done many evil things, and your hands are stained with the blood of innocent people. Today is the day you die."
Before he finished speaking, Xiao Yan twisted his wrist, and the Cold Edge Sword in his hand instantly pierced the guard's throat. Blood spurted out. The guard fell to the ground without even a groan, and died on the spot. Xiao Yan took back the Cold Edge Sword and raised his hand to wipe off the blood on the sword. The sword's icy cold light returned again. He looked at the two corpses on the ground without any fluctuation in his eyes. In his opinion, the death of these evil-doers was not a pity. Their death was just a glimmer of justice for those innocent souls.
Xiao Yan took a deep breath, suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, and scanned the surroundings with vigilance. After confirming that there were no other guards, he continued to move towards the entrance of the cave. He knew that the next road would be more difficult and dangerous. There were more than 300 guards in Black Wind Stronghold and countless traps., and Hu Xiaotian himself has strong martial arts skills and ruthless heart. It is not easy to kill him. But he had no choice. The flame of revenge had been burning in his heart for three years. Today, he must destroy Heifeng Village and make Hu Xiaotian pay with his blood. He would avenge the entire sect and all the innocent people who were harmed by Hu Xiaotian.
The passage inside the cave entrance gradually became wider, and the light became brighter and brighter. One could vaguely see an exit not far ahead. From the exit, faint voices and footsteps could be heard. Xiao Yan knew that that was the inside of Black Wind Village. He slowed down his pace, lowered his figure, and cautiously approached the exit. His eyes scanned the movement in front of him with vigilance. He held the Cold Edge Sword tightly in his hand, ready to deal with possible dangers at any time.
He slowly poked his head out and carefully observed the scene inside Black Wind Village through the light from the exit. Inside Heifeng Village, the layout is chaotic, with low wooden houses everywhere. The walls of the wooden houses are made of mud, and the roofs are covered with thatch, which makes them look particularly simple. There were some weapons and sundries scattered around the wooden house, as well as some guards in black, patrolling back and forth, looking alert. In the distance, there is a tall main hall. The main hall is made of blue bricks, and the roof is covered with black tiles. It looks particularly majestic. That is the main hall of Heifeng Village, and Hu Xiaotian is inside.
Xiao Yan's eyes were fixed on the hall, and the hatred in his eyes almost overflowed. He knew that Hu Xiaotian was in that hall, and his enemy was right in front of him. Three years of forbearance, three years of wandering, three years of hard training, just for this moment today. He slowly tightened his grip on the Hanfeng Sword in his hand, and the sword trembled slightly, as if in response to the hatred and determination in his heart.
The new wind is still howling in the sky above Black Wind Village, rolling up the sky with wind and sand. Under the eaves of the main hall, hanging lanterns sway in the strong wind, emitting a faint light, reflecting this village full of sin and blood. Xiao Yan took a deep breath, suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, and jumped out from the exit in a flash, like an eagle with spread wings, quietly approaching the main hall. His steps are light and firm, and every step is a step towards the end of revenge; every step carries the hope and hatred of countless wronged souls.
The cold sand buries old grudges, and the sharp sword points directly at the evil nest. Xiao Yan knew that a bloody battle was about to break out. He didn't know whether he could walk out of this Black Wind Stronghold alive, or whether he could succeed in revenge, but he knew that he would not flinch or be afraid. Even if he tried his best, even if he was shattered into pieces, he would make Hu Xiaotian pay with his blood and let the injured souls rest in peace. His figure, amidst the wind and sand in the sky, looked extremely thin, yet extremely firm, like a weed in the cold sand, growing tenaciously in the violent storm, moving towards the source of evil step by step with endless hatred and determination.
